holes: Registry says research asset, not investible business.
Deliverability to government inboxes may fail.
Legal-adjacent AI letters can create regulatory, reputational, and defamation exposure.
Local official coverage is currently stubbed.
Free substitutes may be good enough.
mitigations: Citation verification, moderation, audit logging, and opt-out handling.
Local provider spike before paid traffic.
Measure paid conversion, not preview usage alone.
residualRisks: One unsafe letter can reset trust.
Official domains can still classify mail as spam.
CAC may exceed low transaction revenue.

strategy.nearTerm: Validate paid, safe, delivered civic letters with a narrow concierge beta.
strategy.doNotDo: Do not scale SEO, paid ads, or organization sales before coverage and safety gates pass.

goToMarket.first100Customers: Manual outreach to issue-specific local civic communities and concierge beta users.
channels: Opt-in SEO pages only after legal/operator review

operatorWorkflow.daily: Review flagged submissions, delivery failures, bounce/complaint events, and treasury alerts.
operatorWorkflow.launchConstraint: No unattended public scale until operator has reviewed beta incidents and queue load.

constraints: Workspace-only research; no external market validation.

metrics.unitEconomics: Revenue covers direct cost, processor cost, and operator review time.

unknowns: Whether operator wants to pitch this as a business.
